Class InternshipOpportunity

java.lang.Object
internshipPlacementManagementSystem.InternshipOpportunity
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class InternshipOpportunity
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable
Represents an internship opportunity created by a company representative that students can apply for.
